Consonantal i

Theme

Household, washing & chores

throw out verb

of the house

also kick out, turn out, chuck out, drive out, evict, expel

classical

Plaut. Asin. 632: hinc mēd amantem ex aedibus ējēcit hujus māter
Caes. BC 1.30.3: ex oppidō (Lewis & Short)

ējiciō, ējicere, ējēcī, ējectum

verb, third conjugation

throw out, drive out, turn out

Other words

  • extrūdō, extrūdere, extrūsī, extrūsum — push out, bundle out of doors

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Plaut. Aul. 44: Nam quā mē nunc causā extrūsistī ex aedibus?; Cic. de Or. 2.234: tē in viam … extrūdam et ējiciam (Lewis & Short)

Examples

  • Nam quā mē nunc causā extrūsistī ex aedibus?

    Now why have you pushed me out of the house?Plaut. Aul. 44

  • Sīcine hoc fit? forās aedibus mē ējicī?

    Is this how it goes? Me, thrown out of the house?Plaut. Asin. 127

See also get rid of, throw, go, push.

SourcesLewis & Short: eicio · Lewis & Short: extrudo

Plautus, Asinaria 127, 632; Aulularia 44.
